2608.02948.title: Rubrics as Privileged Information for Open-Ended Generation
2608.02948.paper_summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD), where a single model acts as both student and teacher with different contexts, has shown promise in verifiable domains like math, where hard privileged information (PI) in the form of ground-truth answers structurally constrains valid continuations. We extend OPSD to open-ended generation using soft PI in the form of rubrics that guide preferences but admit many valid responses. Rubrics have served as scalar rewards for reinforcement learning (RL); we show that they provide substantially richer signal as dense PI for distillation, and contrary to intuition, soft rubric PI provides a larger and more effective training signal on student roll-outs than hard reference completion PI in this regime. A reference completion is one point in a set of valid responses, so distilling towards it over-constrains the student, while rubrics specify the preference structure shared across the set of valid responses. We show the effectiveness of using rubrics as PI for open-ended generation across Qwen and Llama model families and show that it outperforms rubric-as-reward (RaR) RL using HealthBench, a benchmark that grades open-ended health responses against physician-created rubrics, providing dense token-level supervision for open-ended tasks; RuPI beats RaR RL by up to +0.10 absolute score and, under matched recipe and KL direction, beats reference-PI by +0.034 to +0.079 absolute score across three models. We further show that these findings generalize to training on the RubricHub Science corpus and evaluating on ResearchQA: soft rubric PI outperforms both reference-PI distillation and RaR RL (66.6% vs. 64.2% and 57.6%).
2608.02948.paper_summary_zh: 在政策自我蒸餾（OPSD）中，單一模型在不同的上下文中同時擔任學生和教師，這在可驗證的領域如數學中顯示出潛力，因為以真實答案形式存在的硬特權信息（PI）結構性地約束了有效的延續。我們將OPSD擴展到使用軟特權信息的開放式生成，這些信息以指導偏好的評分標準形式存在，但允許多種有效的回應。評分標準作為強化學習（RL）的標量獎勵；我們顯示它們作為密集的PI提供了更豐富的信號，而與直覺相反，軟評分標準PI在學生的回合中提供了比硬參考完成PI更大且更有效的訓練信號。參考完成是有效回應集合中的一個點，因此朝著它進行蒸餾會過度約束學生，而評分標準則指定了在有效回應集合中共享的偏好結構。我們展示了在Qwen和Llama模型系列中使用評分標準作為開放式生成的PI的有效性，並顯示它在使用HealthBench的情況下超越了作為獎勵的評分標準（RaR）RL，HealthBench是一個根據醫生創建的評分標準對開放式健康回應進行評分的基準，為開放式任務提供密集的標記級監督；RuPI在絕對分數上超越RaR RL達到+0.10，並且在匹配的配方和KL方向下，在三個模型中超越參考PI達到+0.034到+0.079的絕對分數。我們進一步顯示這些發現可以推廣到RubricHub Science語料庫的訓練和ResearchQA的評估：軟評分標準PI超越了參考PI蒸餾和RaR RL（66.6%對64.2%和57.6%）。
